critical_code_review_comments: ExecutiveTeam cards currently render initials + 'Photo pending' placeholders instead of real headshots — intentional placeholder per design (acceptable, not a bug). When real photos arrive, swap the gradient placeholder in /app/frontend/src/components/home/ExecutiveTeam.jsx for an in the existing photo slot.

ProductionVideo play button is a stub — clicking shows a 'coming soon' toast. When real MP4 footage is available, wire a <video> element to onPlay in /app/frontend/src/components/home/ProductionVideo.jsx (already noted in code comment 'VIDEO SLOT').

Cursor.jsx attaches global mousemove + mouseover + rAF tick — fine for current site, but if perf becomes an issue, throttle the magnetic loop using IntersectionObserver to only run when [data-magnetic] elements are in view.

Heidelberg/Kodak/etc are listed BOTH as machinery suppliers (correct) AND as 'Media Partners' marketing strip — semantically 'Media Partners' is an unusual label for equipment vendors; consider renaming the strip to 'Our Technology Partners' or 'Powered By' for clarity. Not a bug.
ExecCard onMouseMove transform may interact with cursor.js [data-magnetic] transforms if data-magnetic is added later — currently safe since the cards don't carry [data-magnetic].
